proposed_operations.payload: {"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"concept","status":"tentative","title":"Goal alignment and value alignment","statement":"Goal alignment concerns pursuing assigned objectives. Value alignment concerns applying human principles under ambiguity or unfamiliar conditions. The boundary overlaps because interpreting goals requires inferring values. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)"}}

{"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"claim","status":"tentative","title":"Alignment requires generalization beyond training","statement":"Aligned training behavior does not establish alignment in unfamiliar environments. Greater capability introduces situations where learned values may generalize incorrectly. Alignment must also persist when models believe supervision is absent. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)"}}

{"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"evidence","status":"tentative","title":"OpenAI reports declining reasoning monitorability","statement":"Pachocki reports evaluations showing diminishing reliance on chain-of-thought monitoring.
